Pregabalin Hardcore Report
I have used many drugs over the years and refer to myself as a recreational user. I'm from N.Ireland and pregabalin became available through prescription in around 2009 and I have used it since then. All in around 5 years.
In 2007 I landed myself in prison and was prescribed tramadol and robaxin
, while inside. At around 2009 a new drug was being made available, which had great recreational side effects, so obviously there was great talk of this at the time as prisoners will do anything for a hit. The surprising thing was the doctors who were well known bastards were handing it out at ease. The whole dynamic of the prison changed, everyone was at peace.
The whole dynamic of the prison changed, everyone was at peace.
When I was released in 2010 naturally I went straight to my doctor to get on the lyrica, he hadn't really ever prescribed them although he had heard of them, I thought people would be breaking his door down as in working class areas over here they love pharmaceuticals. Anyway I started offering them to my friends and they in turn had never heard of them
. I feel privelaged to have been an original guinea pig for these tablets.
I would get a months supply (56-300mg tablets) and of an evening take a weeks worth, which is around 4200mg, I would rate these as the best drug in the world.
I do not mix with codene = death, but safe for anything up to 8000mg
